record.direction: Initial restriction direction not separately specified; later documented mode is Lebanon to Syria pedestrians.

record.exceptions: UNFPA reports Arida reopened 13 December without category details; by 2 January one-way pedestrian crossing into Syria was documented.
record.imposing_authority: Israeli military strikes; Lebanese General Security closure order
record.enforcement: Scope-limited evidence; uniform enforcement beyond the named crossings and movement categories is not inferred.
record.relationship: Renewed Arida phase after R3-ME-004; broad 6 December order also affects Qaa but is not duplicated as a second all-border event.

record.uncertainty: 13 December reopening is humanitarian-report evidence with no category specification. Vehicle movement cannot be inferred. June 2025 vehicle reopening must not be treated as the first reopening since November.
